input.question: What is the population of Croydon Park?

documents.text: Croydon Kings is located on the eastern side of Croydon Park. As of 2011 Census, Croydon Park had a population of 3,998: 49.7% female and 50.3% male. The median age of the Croydon Park population was 36 years, 1 year below the national median of 37. 47.5% of people living in Croydon Park were born in Australia. The other top responses for country of birth were Vietnam 10.4%, India 4.8%, Greece 2.9%, Italy 2.8%, China 2.1%. 40.3% of people spoke only English at home; the next most common languages were, 14.5% Vietnamese, 6.8% Greek, 4.4% Italian, 2.1% Khmer, 2% Punjabi.
